literal: Joy (is) a sea, but love, when that afflicts, sorrow (is) bigger than that.
translation: The joy of love is as vast as the sea. But when it afflicts, the sorrow is even greater than the sea.
modern: காமத்தால் வரும் இன்பம் கடல் அளவு பெரியது; ஆனால் அது துன்புறுத்தும்போது வரும் துன்பம் கடலை விடப் பெரியது.
explanation: The speaker compares the joy of love to the vastness of the sea. However, when love brings separation and longing, the resulting sorrow is even greater than the sea itself. The word 'அடுங்கால்' (when it afflicts) highlights the intense pain of unfulfilled desire. Thus, the couplet contrasts the immense pleasure of love with its even more overwhelming pain.
